title: Halloween Havoc: Play free on browser now!
author: MapApprehensive1867
selftext:
*Halloween Havoc: Zombie Shooter*, a side-scrolling run-and-gun where you blast your way through hordes of undead in haunted graveyards, crypts and moonlit ruins.



What's in it:

\- 22 guns: stake shotguns, flamethrowers, a spectral laser, rocket launchers, a saw launcher, a tesla gun, a minigun and more

\- A big undead roster: mummies, hellhounds, vampire bats, wraith knights, plague sorcerers, plus tougher elite variants

\- Boss fights, including the Pumpkin Horror and the Grave Golem

\- 7 heroes to unlock, each with their own stats

\- 41 maps across Campaign, endless Survival and Escort modes

\- Skills like homing missiles, laser strikes and area blasts

\- Keyboard + mouse on desktop, touch controls on mobile

\- No downloads and no sign-up needed

It runs right in the browser, so it's quick to jump into for a few waves.



Play here: [https://playgama.ai/play/dq7kwy3wckv7o3](https://playgama.ai/play/dq7kwy3wckv7o3)
